<panel>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<parent>ContextBase</parent>
	<overrides>
<page>Panel:Clear</page>
<page>ContextBase:TestForChanges</page>
<page>PANEL:Init</page>
<page>PANEL:PerformLayout</page>
	</overrides>
	<description>Used in Sandbox tools to allow the player to select models out of a list. Despite being only used in Sandbox, it is **not** exclusive to that gamemode.

See also <page>MatSelect</page> for the material selecting alternative.
</description>
</panel>

<example>
<description>
Example usage of the panel.
</description>
<code>
local frame = vgui.Create( "DFrame" )
frame:SetSize( 500, 500 )
frame:Center()
frame:MakePopup()

local PropSelect = vgui.Create( "PropSelect", frame )
PropSelect:Dock( TOP )

--PropSelect:SetConVar( "my_convar_name" ) 

local items = {
	"models/props_c17/FurnitureWashingmachine001a.mdl",
	"models/props_junk/PlasticCrate01a.mdl",
	"models/props_junk/wood_pallet001a.mdl"
}

for k, model in pairs( items ) do
	PropSelect:AddModelEx( model, model, 0 )
end

function PropSelect:OnSelect( model, pnl )
	print( "Selected model", model, pnl )
end
</code>

<output>
<upload src="70c/8dccb703b98e2fa.png" size="42655" name="image.png" />
</output>

</example>
